entries.cf8c2aef485a10bc: This is a single segment centered on the operation of "P-ban.com", an e-commerce service for printed circuit boards. Based on the board specifications a customer selects on the Web, it automatically selects the factory that is optimal in price, delivery time and quality from among domestic and overseas partner suppliers, and presents quotations matched to multiple delivery time courses. Customers can place an order simply by choosing a quotation and delivery time and uploading their design drawings. The company operates as a fabless business and has no factory of its own. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,311 million, of which E-commerce services accounted for ¥2,200 million and other for ¥110 million. It has also opened "p-ban Thailand", an online shopping site for the Kingdom of Thailand.
